decision.title: Casting and lexical forms (packet )
decision.summary: Casting takes the atomized operand and any atomic, list, union, enumeration or choice target, follows XSD 1.1 lexical spaces, and casts nested targets on an explicit stack of cast frames.

body.p: . src/cast_internal.h; src/cast.c (casting table, targets), src/cast_lexical.c (lexical forms, canonical text).

item.p: Interface: sxml_cast_make_value and sxml_cast_test_castability take the atomized operand (atomizing is the evaluator's) and any target type: atomic, list, union, enumeration or choice; a target that cannot be cast to gives XPST0080 at run time too. sxml_cast_make_value_from_text casts text as an xs:string without making one (list tokens use it). sxml_cast_write_canonical_text borrows the text of strings and decimals, writes the rest to the caller's buffer and reports the size needed on CAPACITY_EXCEEDED (96 bytes hold every number, date and duration).

xs:QName: the request carries the statically known namespaces as an sxml_namespace_binding_view (prefix 0: default namespace for elements and types), predeclared prefixes as fallback; no callback interface. XPTY0117 (coercing untypedAtomic to xs:QName) stays with the evaluator.

Checks: syntax here, value space in sxml_atomic_item_make, whose INVALID_ARGUMENT becomes FORG0001. XSD 1.1 lexical spaces: "+INF" accepted, base64 with single spaces, year of 4 to 16 digits ("-0000" refused, more is FODT0001), 24:00:00 is the next day, fraction digits past nine truncated (), duration parts beyond int64_t FODT0002; digits beyond the heap's limit FOCA0003 (integer targets) or FOCA0001.

Numbers: xs:double and xs:float write the shortest digits () as a decimal when the first significant digit's power of ten is -6 to 5, else as d.dddEn, so xs:float("1e-6") writes 0.000001. To integer types truncates (doubles beyond 2^63 by their exact value); to xs:decimal the shortest decimal. Text to float goes through strtof (one rounding) on locale-free text, as .

Unions and choices: an instance of an atomic member is returned unchanged, otherwise members in order; when all fail XPTY0004 if every member refused the source type, else FORG0001 (xs:error: FORG0001). Enumerations: cast to xs:string, then codepoint membership; the result is an xs:string. Lists: only from the string types (XPTY0004), collapsed and split, no tokens is FORG0001. Targets nest at most 32 deep (LIMIT_EXCEEDED beyond): unions, choices and lists are cast on an explicit stack of cast frames in heap memory (), grown up to 33.
castable: dynamic and type errors of the cast give false; errors reading the operand, XPST0080, memory and limits are returned.
